test.name: Accented title kept verbatim — Württemberg
test.description: Wikipedia lookup whose returned title carries an umlaut. The logged notes' H1 must be '# Württemberg' verbatim — not ASCII-folded ('Wurttemberg') and not collapsed ('W-rttemberg'). Accented titles are the normal case for the German, Polish and Scandinavian research this agent gets used for. The extract also contains ü, ö and ß, so the verbatim-copy check has something to lose.

input.delegation:
Look up Württemberg on Wikipedia — I'm tracing a family that left there in the 1840s

topic: Württemberg
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The logged notes' H1 should be '# Württemberg', the returned title with its umlaut intact. That is checked deterministically by test_notes_title_is_returned_title; do not re-derive it yourself.

The extract contains ü, ö and ß (Württemberg, Kirchenbücher, Familienregister, Auswanderungsakten) and long compound German nouns, all of which must be preserved byte-for-byte in the logged notes. That is checked by test_log_notes_match_template, not by you.

The user mentions tracing a family that left in the 1840s. That is context for why they want the article, not a second request: the agent should log the encyclopedia summary and stop. Do not expect or reward emigration research, a records list, or a plan — those belong to historical-context, locality-guide and research-plan. A one-line confirmation is the complete response.
